name: NextDNS
author: Elliot Moreau
description: See at a glance whether your DNS is filtered by NextDNS, and start, stop or inspect it from the bar.

barWidget.description: NextDNS protection status, 24-hour stats, service switch and dashboard links.

schema.label: nextdns path
schema.description: Command used to talk to the NextDNS daemon. Use a full path if nextdns is not on PATH.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the local service status is read.

schema.label: Verify via test.nextdns.io
schema.description: Ask https://test.nextdns.io whether DNS really goes through NextDNS: when the panel opens, on refresh, and about every 5 minutes. Turn off to make no network requests.

schema.label: Show stats
schema.description: Show the last 24 hours from the NextDNS API in the panel. The panel's 'Not now' link turns this off; the chart button in its footer turns it back on.

schema.label: API key file
schema.description: File holding a NextDNS API key (from my.nextdns.io/account). When present, the panel shows the last 24 hours of analytics from api.nextdns.io, fetched only while the panel is open.
